name: Banking
description: Fictional Harbor Ridge Bank: fee schedule v1 and v2, savings terms, an internal dispute procedure and a credit card distractor, with stale, unanswerable and distractor traps.
risk_rules: Never quote an outdated fee or limit from a superseded fee schedule as current.
Do not state rates, fees or terms that the documents do not give; abstain instead.
Do not apply credit card terms to checking, savings or debit card accounts.
Do not reveal internal-only procedure details, such as fraud referrals, to customers.

test_cases.question: What is the overdraft fee?

gold.quote: The overdraft fee is $25 per item when the bank pays a transaction that overdraws the account.

stale.quote: The overdraft fee is $35 per item when the bank pays a transaction that overdraws the account.

test_cases.question: What minimum daily balance do I need to avoid the monthly maintenance fee on Everyday Checking?

gold.quote: The monthly maintenance fee is waived when the account keeps a minimum daily balance of $1,000 for the entire statement cycle.

stale.quote: The monthly maintenance fee is waived when the account keeps a minimum daily balance of $1,500 for the entire statement cycle.

test_cases.question: How much does it cost to withdraw cash at an out-of-network ATM?
test_cases.ground_truth_answer: $2.50 per withdrawal, plus any ATM owner fee

gold.quote: Each withdrawal at an out-of-network ATM costs $2.50, in addition to any fee charged by the ATM owner.

stale.quote: Each withdrawal at an out-of-network ATM costs $3.00, in addition to any fee charged by the ATM owner.

test_cases.question: How much does an outgoing international wire transfer cost?

gold.quote: An outgoing international wire transfer costs $40 per transfer when sent through online banking and $50 per transfer when sent through a branch.

stale.quote: An outgoing international wire transfer costs $45 per transfer.

test_cases.note: v1 had a flat $45; v2 splits into $40 online and $50 branch. Also overlaps with 'international' wording in the credit card distractor.

test_cases.question: What annual percentage yield does the Everyday Savings account pay on a balance of $25,000?

gold.quote: Balances from $10,000 to $49,999.99 earn an annual percentage yield of 1.25%.

test_cases.note: Requires picking the middle tier from three adjacent tiers.

test_cases.question: What is the fee for each savings withdrawal beyond the monthly limit?
test_cases.ground_truth_answer: $10 per excess withdrawal (after 6 per statement cycle)

gold.quote: Each withdrawal beyond the sixth in a statement cycle incurs an excess withdrawal fee of $10.

test_cases.question: After how long without activity does a savings account become dormant?
test_cases.ground_truth_answer: 12 consecutive months with no customer-initiated activity

gold.quote: An account becomes dormant when there is no customer-initiated activity for 12 consecutive months.

test_cases.question: What documents must staff collect when a customer opens a dispute?
test_cases.ground_truth_answer: A signed Dispute Affidavit (form DR-12), a copy of the account statement, and any receipts or merchant correspondence

gold.quote: Staff must collect a signed Dispute Affidavit (form DR-12), a copy of the relevant account statement, and any receipts or correspondence with the merchant.

test_cases.question: When is an unresolved dispute escalated to the Dispute Review Team?
test_cases.ground_truth_answer: If it is not resolved within 30 calendar days

gold.quote: Step 2: If a case is not resolved within 30 calendar days, it is escalated to the Dispute Review Team.

test_cases.question: When is the monthly fee waived on a savings account?
test_cases.ground_truth_answer: When the daily balance stays at or above $300, or with an automatic monthly transfer of at least $25 from Harbor Ridge checking

gold.quote: The $5 monthly service fee is waived when the account keeps a minimum daily balance of $300 or when the customer sets up an automatic monthly transfer of at least $25 from a Harbor Ridge checking account.

test_cases.note: 'Fee is waived' also appears for the credit card annual fee and the checking maintenance fee.

test_cases.question: How many days does a customer have to report an unauthorized international transaction on their card?
test_cases.ground_truth_answer: 60 calendar days after the statement date it first appeared on

gold.quote: Customers must report an unauthorized debit card or electronic transaction within 60 calendar days after the statement date on which the transaction first appeared.

test_cases.note: 'International', 'card' and 'days' pull toward the credit card International Use and welcome-offer chunks.

test_cases.question: How many days until a customer receives a credit after disputing a charge?
test_cases.ground_truth_answer: Provisional credit is posted within 10 business days of receiving the dispute

gold.quote: Provisional credit is posted to the account within 10 business days of receiving the dispute and the customer is notified in writing within 2 business days of posting.

test_cases.note: The credit card doc says a statement credit for a promotional charge billed in error posts within 2 billing cycles.
